057import static org.microbean.bean.BeanTypes.legalBeanType;

059/**
060 * An immutable {@link AbstractList} of {@link TypeMirror}s that contains only {@linkplain
061 * BeanTypes#legalBeanType(TypeMirror) legal bean types}, sorted in a specific manner.
062 *
063 * @author <a href="https://about.me/lairdnelson" target="_top">Laird Nelson</a>
064 *
065 * @see #of(Domain, Collection)
066 */
067public final class BeanTypeList extends AbstractList<TypeMirror> implements Constable {
068
069  private final Domain domain; // for Constable only
070
071  private final List<TypeMirror> types;
072
073  private final int interfaceIndex;
074
075  private BeanTypeList(final Domain domain, final Collection<? extends TypeMirror> types) {
076    super();
077    Objects.requireNonNull(types, "types");
078    if (types instanceof BeanTypeList btl) {
079      this.domain = btl.domain;
080      this.types = btl.types;
081      this.interfaceIndex = btl.interfaceIndex;
082    } else {
083      this.domain = domain;
084      final int size = types.size();
085      if (size == 0) {
086        this.types = List.of();
087        this.interfaceIndex = -1;
088      } else {
089        final ArrayList<TypeMirror> newTypes;
090        if (types instanceof SupertypeList stl) {
091          // SupertypeList instances are already sorted, which is why we check here. Now we can (potentially) avoid
092          // copying, too, since we can use List#copyOf() in the sunny-day case.
093          int i = 0;
094          for (; i < size; i++) {
095            if (!legalBeanType(stl.get(i))) {
096              break;
097            }
098          }
099          if (i == size) {
100            // All types were legal, everything is sorted
101            newTypes = null;
102            this.types = List.copyOf(types);
103            this.interfaceIndex = stl.interfaceIndex();
104          } else {
105            newTypes = new ArrayList<>(size);
106            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
107              newTypes.add(stl.get(j)); // the type is known to be legal
108            }
109            ++i; // skip past the illegal type that was encountered
110            for (; i < size; i++) {
111              final TypeMirror t = stl.get(i);
112              if (legalBeanType(t)) {
113                newTypes.add(t);
114              }
115            }
116            newTypes.trimToSize();
117            this.types = newTypes.isEmpty() ? List.of() : unmodifiableList(newTypes);
118            this.interfaceIndex = this.types.isEmpty() || stl.interfaceIndex() >= this.types.size() ? -1 : stl.interfaceIndex();
119          }
120        } else {
121          newTypes = new ArrayList<>(size);
122          for (final TypeMirror t : types) {
123            if (legalBeanType(t)) {
124              newTypes.add(t);
125            }
126          }
127          if (newTypes.isEmpty()) {
128            this.types = List.of();
129            this.interfaceIndex = -1;
130          } else {
131            newTypes.trimToSize();
132            if (newTypes.size() > 1) {
133              // You might be tempted to include a Comparator that verifies that type variables come first. Normally that
134              // would be good, but a type variable is not a legal bean type.
135              Collections.sort(newTypes,
136                               Comparator.comparing(TypeMirror::getKind,
137                                                    PrimitiveTypesThenDeclaredTypesTypeKindComparator.INSTANCE)
138                               .thenComparing(new SpecializationComparator(domain))
139                               .thenComparing(this::elementKind,
140                                              ClassesThenInterfacesElementKindComparator.INSTANCE)
141                               .thenComparing(Types::erasedName));
142            }
143            this.types = unmodifiableList(newTypes);
144            int interfaceIndex = -1;
145            for (int i = 0; i < newTypes.size(); i++) {
146              final ElementKind k = this.elementKind(newTypes.get(i));
147              if (k != null && k.isInterface()) {
148                interfaceIndex = i;
149                break;
150              }
151            }
152            this.interfaceIndex = interfaceIndex;
153          }
154        }
155      }
156    }
157  }
158
159  private ElementKind elementKind(final TypeMirror t) {
160    final Element e = this.domain.element(t);
161    return e == null ? null : e.getKind();
162  }
163
164  @Override // AbstractList<TypeMirror>
165  public final TypeMirror get(final int index) {
166    return this.types.get(index);
167  }
168
169  /**
170   * Returns the index of the first interface type this {@link BeanTypeList} contains, or a negative value if it
171   * contains no interface types.
172   *
173   * @return the index of the first interface type this {@link BeanTypeList} contains, or a negative value if it
174   * contains no interface types
175   */
176  public final int interfaceIndex() {
177    return this.interfaceIndex;
178  }
179
180  @Override // AbstractList<TypeMirror>
181  public final boolean isEmpty() {
182    return this.types.isEmpty();
183  }
184
185  @Override // Constable
186  public final Optional<? extends ConstantDesc> describeConstable() {
187    return (this.domain instanceof Constable c ? c.describeConstable() : Optional.<ConstantDesc>empty())
188      .flatMap(domainDesc -> Constables.describeConstable(this.types)
189               .map(typesDesc -> DynamicConstantDesc.of(BSM_INVOKE,
190                                                        MethodHandleDesc.ofMethod(STATIC,
191                                                                                  ClassDesc.of(this.getClass().getName()),
192                                                                                  "of",
193                                                                                  MethodTypeDesc.of(ClassDesc.of(BeanTypeList.class.getName()),
194                                                                                                    ClassDesc.of(Domain.class.getName()),
195                                                                                                    CD_Collection)),
196                                                        domainDesc,
197                                                        typesDesc)));
198  }
199
200  @Override // AbstractList<TypeMirror>
201  public final int size() {
202    return this.types.size();
203  }
204
205
206  /*
207   * Static methods.
208   */
209
210
211  /**
212   * Returns a non-{@code null} {@link BeanTypeList} suitable for the supplied arguments.
213   *
214   * @param domain a {@link Domain} that may be used to determine {@linkplain Domain#subtype(TypeMirror, TypeMirror)
215   * subtype relationships}; may be {@code null} if {@code types} is itself a {@link BeanTypeList}
216   *
217   * @param types a non-{@code null} {@link Collection} of {@link TypeMirror}s; must not be {@code null}
218   *
219   * @return a non-{@code null} {@link BeanTypeList}
220   *
221   * @exception NullPointerException if {@code types} is {@code null}, or if {@code types} is not a {@link BeanTypeList}
222   * and {@code domain} is {@code null}
223   */
224  // Called by describeConstable()
225  public static final BeanTypeList of(final Domain domain, final Collection<? extends TypeMirror> types) {
226    return types instanceof BeanTypeList btl ? btl : new BeanTypeList(domain, types);
227  }
228
229}
